name: Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1970, Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing of Stainless Steel Pipes and Tubes.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1]
a) SS Cold Drawn Seamless Tubes — Heat exchangers, instrumentation, boilers
b) SS Seamless Pipes 
c) SS Welded Tubes - Condensers, low/high pressure heaters, coiled systems
d) SS Welded Pipes - Large diameter pipes, high thick pipes
